# A struct field of funcvar type initialized with an async candidate.
# Calling h.run() from a click handler must await the funcvar field call.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# The click handler wrapper is async because the struct field slot is Async.
grep 'addEventListener.*async function' out/index.html

# The struct field funcvar call site is awaited.
grep 'await state\.h\.run()' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import api "js:./api"

struct Handler {
    run func() string
}

component main {
    var h = Handler{run = api.fetchHello}
    button(text="Go", @click { h.run() })
    text(value="hi")
}

-- api/index.ts --
export async function fetchHello(): Promise<string> { return "hi"; }
